title: ws review --show
description: One file of a task's diffstat as it stands on one side of its review range. A branch review's old side is the merge base, not the integration branch's tip.

rev.description: The full hash of the commit this side was read at.

text.description: The file's content; null when the file doesn't exist on this side, or is binary.

binary.description: True for a file with a NUL byte or that isn't UTF-8; text is then null.
